profile_text.body:
The National Student Clearinghouse is a nonprofit that describes itself as a source for trusted, authenticated, and secure education data insights. It says its verification, data exchange, and compliance services help institutions maximize time, resources, and knowledge, and that it provides educators, learners, businesses, and policymakers with data for the right use at the right time. Its site also addresses spoofing in higher education, noting that spoofing has become more sophisticated in the age of artificial intelligence and describing awareness of its forms and signs as one way to help combat it.

The organization's tracked product is the National Student Clearinghouse itself, listed under Education & Research AI. No AI features are recorded for it. It is used for college enrollment and completion tracking, by district and counseling staff, and is a staff tool rather than one for students. Use requires a signed StudentTracker agreement. StudentTracker for High Schools is priced at $595 per high school per year for unlimited use.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the organization.
